purpose: Make the result depend on a variable factor.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
N + 次第で / 次第だ
We will change the destination depending on the weather.
It can last a long time depending on how you use it.
Whether to participate is up to you.
formation: N + 次第で / 次第だ
restrictions: Often implies that changing the factor changes the outcome.
mistake: Unlike Vます stem + 次第, this use is not “as soon as”.
